title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Vileplume 045/165 Holo Rare Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Vileplume card is a must-have for any serious collector of Japanese Pokémon cards. With its stunning holo design, this card is sure to be a showpiece in your collection. The card features the iconic Vileplume character and is a single card from the 2023 series. 

This original card is manufactured by POKEMON and is part of the Japanese language series. It has a card number of 045/165 and is sold by a US seller. Don't miss your chance to add this rare and valuable card to your collection today.
